readings.description: Total axis-geometry length of all IfcWall elements on storey 1.OG (GlobalId 0Lz7dRJK5CdfSh5PhR5gUV) of the registered IFC source: 70 of 70 expected walls measured, complete. The cited text IDs confirm this sheet is the 1.OG plan generated from the IFC.

notes: Storey GlobalId 0Lz7dRJK5CdfSh5PhR5gUV corresponds to '1.OG' in source ifc-26734e67bdc0fd2ab30cb560 (IFC4, project 'Smiley West', length unit metres; per model_inventory).
Length basis is explicit IFC axis polylines computed from native geometry (computed_geometry), not author-reported source quantities; opening subtraction is not applicable to wall axis length.
The plan image was used only as context; wall totals were not derived from the raster drawing.
